use.style: fill: var(--fig-morado, #7c3aed); stroke: var(--fig-morado, #7c3aed)

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--fig-texto, var(--fig-texto, #101418))

path.style: fill: none; stroke: var(--fig-azul, #2563eb); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square

use.style: fill: var(--fig-azul, #2563eb); stroke: var(--fig-azul, #2563eb); stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--fig-texto, var(--fig-texto, #101418))
